state: I knocked out my front tooth playing hockey twenty minutes ago and it's bleeding a lot.

in_pain.instructions: The sender says they are in pain right now.

department.instructions: Which department should take this message?

criteria.restorative: Fillings, crowns, chipped or broken teeth, lost fillings
criteria.surgery: Extractions, wisdom teeth, implants, post-operative care
criteria.front_desk: Scheduling, forms, hours, directions, records requests

urgency.instructions: How urgently does this message need attention?
criteria: Routine: can wait for the next regular visit
Soon: book within a few weeks
This week: schedule in the next few days
Emergency: go to the practice or an emergency room now
